sn22.74:1.2: “Bhikkhus, the uninstructed worldling does not understand as it really is the origin and the passing away, the gratification,
sn22.74:1.6: the danger, and the escape in the case of form, feeling, perception, volitional formations, and consciousness.
sn22.74:1.7: “But, bhikkhus, the instructed noble disciple understands as it really is the origin and the passing away, the gratification,
sn22.74:1.11: the danger, and the escape in the case of form, feeling, perception, volitional formations, and consciousness.”
